mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: An open source, free Heroku alternative platform for deploying applications, built to deliver the developer experience Heroku provided, with recent experimentation and integration of MCP.
mentions.problem: Even after all these years, the developer experience that Heroku provided is still missing.
mentions.audience: Developers actively deploying apps; over 2000 developers used it last month.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on an open source, free, Heroku alternative at https://canine.sh for about two years.
